[*] New map

The journey doesn't end here! We're committed to continually supporting Builders of Greece with regular updates, bug fixes, and possibly even more exciting content based on your ongoing feedback.

Thank you for joining us on this building adventure.

Lead your people 👥, craft your legacy 📜, and shape history 🏺!


⚒️Happy building⚒️
Builders of Greece Development Team🏗️

notes.title: Age of War milestone - Update #3
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
It's been a while, but we're back with another update. And this is the big one! Before we discuss all the novelties we prepared for you, let us thank you for your awesome feedback, rulers. Your opinions have been instrumental in helping us craft a series of improvements to enhance your adventure. Rest assured, we’re [b]always keeping an eye on your ideas and comments[/b], and we deeply value your continued support in shaping the future of the game.


[b]And now - Update #3![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/593e662bef81c1e0667470bda9d13f51072a5292.png[/img]


[h2]Age of War Milestone - Update #3 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]Major changes:[/h3]
• Added a new Sacrifices feature to enhance players' relationships with the gods
• Added information about the risk of sickness occurring
• Added new tooltip showcasing the house dwellers' happiness
• Added information about the produced and consumed goods balance in the production buildings
• Added a new consumption system that makes citizens use the given resource globally, instead of dividing its consumption to every single house
• Wide-ranging rebalance of the economy (resources extraction, production and services)
• Fixed a bug where Stables produced wood
• Fixed bugs related to saving and loading the game
• Improvements to the military units recruitment (faster recruitment time when more military buildings are available)
• Military units now travel faster
• From now on, only the available resources are visible in warehouses and on the panel at the top of the screen


[h3]Minor changes:[/h3]
• Added sound for destroying a building
• Added a new information icon when warehouses are full
• Added a new information icon when production buildings are out of needed resources
• Fixed an issue that caused warehouse workers to get stuck
• Fixed an issue where upgrading a building canceled its sickness status
• Fixed an issue with placing farms near farming buildings
• UI improvements to the Tactical Combat panel and a number of other UI improvements
• A number of other minor bug fixes and quality of life improvements
• Numerous optimization and visual fixes


[h2]Join the community 💭[/h2]

As always, we are very happy to hear your feedback and get to know your expectations even better, so visit our social media channels and Discord server to share your thoughts. Thank you, Builders!

notes.title: Builders of Greece full release is coming on May 6, 2025
notes.content:
[h2]Huge news, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Rejoice, emperors! Our journey through the Early Access phase is nearing its end, and soon we will all get to experience the [b]full version of the Builders of Greece project[/b]. While our road to this point has been bumpy and winding at times, thanks to your steadfast commitment, continued support, and invaluable feedback, we can now see the goal... and it's very near.


[h2]Builders of Greece full release is coming on May 6, 2025[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/a0587f11d174dc6ee6872e0c766b2423895e71e3.png[/img]

That's right, [b]in just about 2 months[/b] you will be able to discover all the mechanics, features, scenarios, functionalities and surprises that we have prepared for you. Mark this special date on your calendars, builders, as May 6, 2025 you will sit on the ancient throne in all your glory. 

Know, that our team [b]does everything in its power to provide you with the best possible experience[/b] and irons out the last imperfections as we speak. We are aware that Builders of Greece is not yet completely problem-free, however, we are looking to the future with our heads held high, and we are steadfast in our efforts to ensure that everything goes smooth and according to plan. 

You can expect a lot of new interesting information on the full release soon, so as always - stay tuned!


[h2]Builders of Greece Age of War - Update #3 🛠️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The announcement of the release date does not of course mean that we will stop updating current game content. On the occasion of today's announcement, we would also like to present you the latest changes that have just appeared in our title!


[h3]Age of War - Update #3 changelog:[/h3]
• Added new translations of bonuses awarded by the gods 
• Fixed issues related to loading saved games
• Fixed issues with delivering goods by warehouse workers
• Fixed a bug that allowed to change units movement during their animation
• Fixed a bug that caused destroying a bandit camp to not complete the mission
• Fixed a bug that caused the deletion of a road leading to a warehouse to not display a “no road connection” icon
• Fixed bugs related to lags and stutters, and buildings / resources issues after loading the saved game
• Fixed a bug that caused incorrect display of Chinese letters
• Fixed a number of bugs related to the gods system
• Fixed a bug that caused the Healer's House to not work properly and sick households to increase their happiness
• Fixed a bug that allowed to endlessly replenish one army squad
• Fixed a bug that caused the destruction of a field in an agricultural building not to affect its productivity and production time.
• Adjustments to the buildings' operation areas

As always, we are very happy to hear your feedback and get to know your expectations even better, so visit our social media channels and Discord server to share your thoughts. Thank you, Builders!

notes.title: Age of War milestone - Update #1
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
A few days ago, war came to your empire, and you - the mighty rulers -  clashed with ruthless bandits and tough sea raiders ⚔️ We hope that your first [b]skirmishes in the new tactical combat system[/b] brought you nothing but glorious victories and spoils of war.

While you were fighting to defend your borders, our team prepared [b]the first "Age of War" Milestone update[/b]. With your feedback and support, we were able to quickly pinpoint several issues, which have been addressed in today's fix.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/7c4195381237550f5bce614589e32f2a55e8077e.png[/img]


[h2]Age of War Milestone - Update #1 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Added a new rebellion popup
• Added a new "show hints" option in the Archive panel
• Added new narrator lines
• Added new information about unit maintenance via tooltip
• Added combat auto-resolve option
• Added new unit cards
• Added player army flags as symbols on the minimap
• Fixed a bug that caused fields to not be removed after moving agricultural buildings
• Fixed a drachmas tooltip on HUD when playing in the borderless mode
• Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze after winning a battle
• Fixed a bug that appeared after exiting the main menu
• Fixed civilizational milestones requirements 
• Fixes to some of the crash-causing issues
• Now when launching the game for the first time the window opens at the correct size
• Optimization of game loading time
• Optimization of the building placing process
• Font and translation fixes
• Adjustments to the building ranges / working areas
• Balance and cost changes
• Improved layout of some tooltips
• Environment elements are now returning to normal after the Woodcutter's House has been demolished
• Hunting Lodge and Herbalist buildings no longer destroy trees around the Woodcutter's House
• Adjustments to the economic cycle, combat unit experience, production times, and other balance changes

[h2]Join the community 💭[/h2]
[hr][/hr]

notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Can you hear it? The drums of war sounded once more! We are extremely excited to announce that another milestone on our path to full release has been reached. Behold, emperors - [b]the Age of War is here...[/b]

With this important event, we have a wealth of information we would love to share with you all, so instead of elaborating on the details, we’ll let the [b]changelog and the new Teaser[/b] 🤩 do the talking. "Age of War" is the biggest updates in the Builders of Greece history, so there is much to discuss. And what better way to showcase [b]so many changes[/b] than an epic gameplay video and changelog? Let's dive right in!


[b]🚨 PLEASE NOTE[/b] 🚨 Due to "Age of War" being the biggest patch so far, you may encounter unforeseen bugs and issues, for which we apologize in advance. After installing the update your saves will not work in the new version of the game, but you can still open them after changing the game branch on Steam to Legacy. As always - we appreciate your reports and suggestions on our Discord server. Thank you!

notes.title: Early Access - Patch 0.10.0 🛠️
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Mighty Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Not so long ago, we celebrated the release of the "Great People" milestone presented on our Content RoadMap, but our work continues at full speed. [b]Thanks to your valuable feedback[/b], which you willingly share via Steam, social media channels and our Discord server, we have managed to prepare another significant Patch.

[h3]Brace yourselves, Rulers! Changes are coming...[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
As usual, you can check out all the [b]new features summarized in our Patch Notes[/b]. However, we also invite you to the more descriptive part, which can be found below the novelties list 📜 There, we provide [b]more information[/b] about the changes introduced in the new update and explain in more detail how they will affect your empire and the people inhabiting it. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/a7852732726eec08b34106258aa3faadcf36246d.png[/img]


[h2]Patch 0.10.0 Notes:[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
• Added distinguished food preferences among different social classes and raised the amount of food that all classes eat

• Enhanced pathfinding algorithm for Storage Workers. Storage Workers now pick paths that are shorter and try to pick new ones after building new or destroying existing roads

• The player can now view the path of the Storage Workers more precisely after clicking them

• The importance of Agora and Marketplace has been increased. Houses outside their range (marked with an appropriate icon) cannot refill their local Pantry to its full value, which lowers the overall happiness level of specific social classes

• Performing basic rituals in religious buildings is now easier due to lowering amount and variety of resources needed

• Added new gods-devoted decorations, the construction of which slows down the decline in their Cult Points

• Better balance of prices of the goods when trading. Now every resource is properly valued, and the selling price is lower than buying one

• Changes to the random events - from now on they offer more detailed information, and their effects on gameplay have been rebalanced

• Merchants now inform the player about the goods they offer in advance, even when Polis don't have access to given good

• Wax and Wax Boards will be now more early-game resources

• Relocation of production buildings is now always available

• The number of current employees of the given production building (after its work was suspended) is now displayed correctly

• Enhanced transparency of the Workforce Panel in Economy Panel. Now adjusting priority and boosting specific buildings should be more clear

[h3]PLEASE NOTE 👇[/h3]
Keep a close eye on your city's food supplies after updating the game. The new Patch may cause them to start melting quickly as residents are now consuming more food!



[h2]And now - additional explanations 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
As promised at the beginning of this entry, we’ve also prepared some [b]more in-depth details[/b] about the new changes. They will give you an even better understanding of what will happen in your city thanks to the Patch 0.10.0, so... [b]here they are![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/3077e82705b53cd7471b2562382a428d9fc4c4f1.gif[/img]

[h3]The diet of your subjects 🐟[/h3]
We noticed that overflowing granaries in your Polis were a common sight, and therefore decided to increase the gluttony of each social group, which now prefers a particular type of food. The Thets are most likely to devour fish, representatives of the Zeugitai class relish red meat, and the Geomori may not refuse fish and meat, but it is wheat products that they like best.

[h3]Storage Workers 📦[/h3]
Storage Workers tirelessly move goods around your city, often so focused on their tasks that they miss the designated paths you've set for them. That’s no longer the case. Now, all Storage Workers will follow optimized routes to Warehouses and Production Buildings, responding to every new road created. 

[h3]Capricious Pantheon ⚡[/h3]
The Greek Gods can be capricious at times, but we understand that their anger was not something that should fall so often on your thriving Polis. To remedy this, we sent a delegation all the way to the top of Olympus and convinced each of the Gods to hold back their anger long enough for the city to spread its wings. Performing basic rituals in their name is now easier due to the lowering amount and variety of resources needed. Not to mention new sacred decorations that will slow down the decline in their satisfaction.

[h3]New trading prices ⚖️[/h3]
We have sent our chief economist on a mission to revalidate the prices of goods and resources in other cities, and now you can be sure that each of them is worth the right number of drachmas. It’s up to you to choose if your wealth will come from precious metals, large-scale raw material production, or by mastering a niche sector and trading the most advanced goods.



[h3]Join our Community and talk to our team about your awesome ideas[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
As always, we remain at your disposal on our [b]Social Media, Discord server and Steam Discussions[/b] channels! 📢

notes.title: Great People 🧑 The 2nd RoadMap Milestone is here!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The path was winding and full of surprises, but we’ve at last arrived at [b]the Second Milestone[/b] ✌️, everyone! We are truly thrilled to reach this point, as it marks the next stage in the carefully planned development of our flagship title – [b]Builders of Greece[/b].

And although we have already managed to implement some of its assumptions announced in our[b] Content RoadMap[/b] (we will talk about them below in a moment), there are also completely new features we want to show you. One way or another, our [b]wonderful guests[/b] will soon arrive at the gates of our city, so let's not delay any longer and get straight to the point 📜 [b]We don't want to keep them waiting, do we?[/b]


[h2]The Milestone Overview 📹[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[previewyoutube=_nHsntsUsUw;full][/previewyoutube]


[h2]Making a long story short - what's new? 🧐[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
If after seeing the Overview above you still feel like you want to [b]learn more about the latest Patch[/b], no worries - we got you! We know that many of you want to test the new features introduced with [b]the "Great People" Milestone[/b] right away, so we have prepared a short summary of the most crucial information:


[b]• Great People 👑[/b] - from now on, prominent Greek characters can come to your city, each influencing your society in a different, positive way

[b]• New Economy Panel 📈[/b] - Decide which buildings should work more efficiently and which may slow down. Grant or deny access to goods to your citizens, and manage production in your empire even more precisely

[b]• New events 📜[/b] - Random events are what make the gameplay more engaging and interesting. From now on, you can come across new (both positive and negative) occurrences

[b]• Building Relocation 🔄[/b] - We managed to implement this feature a few weeks ago. Thanks to it, you can freely move buildings that have already been built

[b]• Improved decorations 🌿[/b] - Similar to above, this enhancement is already present in the game. It allows you to decorate your city more accurately, which affects the well-being of your subjects


[url=https://discord.gg/GnTYDgBAHy][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/d91ee3f209b58a99998de4f81963993e0054cfff.jpg[/img]
[/url]


[h2]Great People among the streets of your city 👦[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The arrival of notable, famous and simply powerful figures is [b]always good news[/b] for your empire, hence you should always make sure that they want to honor you with their presence. These finest among the people of Greece are highly desired by rulers across the land, so it is natural that they will choose only properly prepared cities as [b]the destination of their journey.[/b]

In the Great People panel, you will see a [b]list of requirements[/b] presented by each of the iconic figures. When you manage to fulfill it, you can be sure that they will soon knock on the gates of your city 🚪 When this happens, you can accurately track the patron's location and activity, and most importantly - their influence. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/b72dca7889162a658a599602388ccc56b735d41e.gif[/img]

We don't want to deprive you of the pleasure of discovering new characters, so we will only say that they can influence, for example, the production efficiency, your relationship with Gods, research, the combat abilities of your units [b]and much, much more![/b]


[h2]The New Economy Panel 📊[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We're excited to announce the arrival of [b]the new Economy dashboard[/b], as this's a feature you've been asking for in your reviews and Discord chats... and we are always happy to meet your demands 😁 We completely understand why you wanted us to implement it - it turns out that it is difficult to find a more precise and efficient way to manage the city's economy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/a72c0d1ff721d6912cd98bae1efca63958570c03.gif[/img]

With the Panel, for example, you can decide the [b]production efficiency of selected buildings[/b], grant or deny access to particular goods to different social classes, or assign additional workers to your warehouses. In addition, you can easily stop or resume the operation of selected workshops, farms and other useful buildings. [b]This is the power that a true Ruler deserves![/b]


[h2]New Events 📣[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
The Random Event system is already well known to you, and now it's even more [b]engaging, random and unpredictable. [/b]The perverse fate that watches over your Polis may turn out to be [b]capricious or benevolent...[/b] and there is no way to anticipate its next move 🔮

Among the new events are, for example: medicine discovery, trade boom, grace of the Gods, or resource discovery. Sounds pretty friendly, doesn't it? Unfortunately, [b]there are two sides to every coin[/b], with the dark half being, for example: epidemics, pirate ships 🏴‍☠️, resource shortages or even overloaded goods destruction. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/148b4f560b4338007891e35920ca783d27cd74db.gif[/img]

[h1]Thank you for being with us, Builders 🤝[/h1]

notes.title: The latest Patch - Blessing of Olympus - is now LIVE ⚡
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Builders 🏛🖐️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
If you've seen our new [b]Early Access Content RoadMap[/b], you probably know that today, Builders of Greece will welcome some very special guests. Some of them are kind and caring, others do not shy away from violence... and all of them, without exception, are [b]extremely powerful![/b]

Without them, the culture and development of [b]Ancient Greece would not have been the same[/b]. And it's not just about wonderful temples, altars, or the godsfearing everyday life of all social classes 🙏 Shared beliefs helped cement communities, making it easier for them to work together and [b]pursue common goals.[/b] You and your subjects must also stand before the Gods to gain their favor... or ignite their wrath. [b]And so - let's welcome them to your Polis![/b]


[h2]It's time to meet your Patrons 🤓[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
All of the Gods will gladly accept your prayers and appreciation. However, to effectively demonstrate your devotion, [b]you must first prepare an appropriate place.[/b] Religious buildings are perfect for this purpose, the first of which is the Altar. Once the [b]Altar[/b] or other building of this kind finds its place in your city, you will gain access to the new panel shown below 👇

[i](Click to expand)[/i]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/6cb4872876c6c94fd2d777dc354612c8900e966c.png[/img]

In the Faith panel, you can see the [b]satisfaction of individual Gods[/b] and learn how they can help you with their favors. Each of the religious buildings can be dedicated to one of the Patrons, and it is up to you to forge your own mortals-to-Gods strategy! 

Will your Polis become a [b]place of worship[/b], or will you satisfy them with the[b] bare minimum?[/b] Will you commit to one particular God, or will you try to be on good terms with them all? 🤔 [b]The decision is yours alone[/b], and each choice will have its consequences... To make your task easier, we have prepared a short cheat sheet!

[h3]Each God excels in a specific area[/h3]
[hr][/hr]
🏹 [b]Artemis[/b] - Goddess of hunt, wild nature, moon and animals - thanks to her support, your ranged units will be more efficient in battle, and your Hunter's Hut will produce more meat

💕 [b]Aphrodite[/b] - Goddess of love, beauty and desire - with her help, your population will grow and reproduce faster, providing you with a stable influx of new subjects

🍇 [b]Dionysus[/b] - God of wine, theater and ecstasy - through his passion for celebration, he will help you prepare important rituals that other Gods will surely appreciate

🔥 [b]Hephaestus[/b] - God of fire and craftsmanship - thanks to his divine endurance and strength, Hephaestus improves the combat potential of your infantry units

😇 [b]Hestia[/b] - Goddess of family, travelers and newborns - her kindness and caring nature strengthens the bonds between the inhabitants of your city and allows more of them to fit under the roof of one house


[h2]Rituals and the fury of the Gods ⚡[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/7bd7add01b9b4ac5f97c72297e246911368639b3.gif[/img]

The most effective way to win a God's favor is by [b]performing special rituals[/b] in a dedicated place of worship. Preparing such rituals is often time-consuming and can be expensive, as the appropriate goods are needed to carry them out. Nevertheless, as you already know, [b]it is a profitable investment.[/b] Especially since ignoring the jealous Ancient Gods is not a good idea...

[h3]The Gods can show their displeasure in various ways - and none of them are good for your city! 😱 Angry Patrons may, for example:[/h3]

• scare animals away from your hunting grounds
• cause a plague of infertility
• spark off the degradation of tools and valuable items
• turn other divine beings against your Polis
• cause random houses to fall into ruin... 

And unfortunately, there may be more such negative effects! ☠️ With that in mind, be sure to carefully [b]plan your relationships with the inhabitants of Olympus[/b].


[h2]Improvements to the Technology system 📜[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
While the introduction of the Faith system is the biggest change in today's Patch, [b]it is not the only one.[/b] Based on your feedback, we also decided to make a number of changes to another very important feature of the game, namely the [b]Technology system. [/b]

An overhaul of the Technology system is aimed at increasing its influence on the game throughout its course 🧐 This means that your [b]development decisions will now have an even greater impact[/b] on how your entire Polis performs. [b]Moreover[/b], from now on you have the possibility to choose the development path that [b]best suits you[/b], which was not so strongly emphasized before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37828759/f5d2cb0443434c2b834469309a84a6eb32960793.gif[/img]

More specifically, the Technology system has been divided into two kinds of perks: [b]basic and elite[/b] ⭐ The first of them is necessary to push your city forward, while the latter will show their full potential in the mid and late game. [b]Thanks to precisely adjusted gradation[/b], elite perks will affect areas such as various production modifiers or the improvement of combat units.


[h2]New Maps 🗺️[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
Many of you, eager for new challenges, asked about new maps. We have done our best to fulfill this request, and so... we're happy to announce that with today's update, [b]two new unexplored lands have appeared in Sandbox mode[/b]! And this is by no means the end - we will soon present you with even more maps, both in Scenario and Sandbox modes. [b]Explorers, rejoice![/b] 😁

[b]• Olympus Island[/b] - land of plateaus and plains, with a few gentle descents to the blue sea. A perfect place to build a vast, powerful Polis stretching to the horizon. If you dream of a city built at different heights, this place is just perfect.

[b]• Hera Island[/b] - this unique island boasts a long, straight shoreline that can be used for maritime trade and fishing. Inland stretches a vast plain, the edges of which are marked by high, inaccessible yet majestic mountains.

Thank you for your time, Builders! We wish you many new awesome adventures in the mystical world of Ancient Greece. [b]May the Gods bless you all! [/b]🙏

• Adjustments to the balance of food and resource production
